in_marathi.name: Sharwateek
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Blessed with God's grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharwateek हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is blessed with the grace of the gods, Sharwateek is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sharva' meaning God and 'teek' meaning victory or protection.
